prompt:
Original whimsical cosy autumn storybook colouring-book line art in crisp black ink on clean white paper. Use bold rounded outer contours, medium interior lines, smooth lightly hand-drawn organic shapes, medium scene detail, generous closed areas for colouring, and shallow layered depth created only through overlap and sparse contour accents. Render characters, where present, with friendly simplified cartoon proportions and tiny expressive features. No colour, grey, shading, hatching, texture, gradients or solid black fills; maintain a warm, gentle, playful printable feel.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Whimsical cosy autumn storybook colouring-book line art, translated into an original bold-and-easy printable format.; line weight: Bold, clean black outer contours with medium-weight interior details; consistently generous open areas for colouring.; line quality: Smooth rounded digital linework with a lightly hand-drawn organic character; closed, unbroken shapes and crisp edges.; detail level: Medium detail: each page has a clearly readable main vignette with a restrained layer of seasonal decorative details, avoiding tiny marks and dense textures.; character language: Friendly simplified cartoon proportions, with rounded silhouettes, expressive dot-and-curve faces, uncomplicated limbs and clear readable gestures.; background density: Moderately detailed scene backgrounds built in shallow layers, with controlled negative space and broad colourable areas.; composition: One strong focal vignette per page, supported by a simple foreground and receding background; balanced detail distribution and no text-dependent storytelling.; palette: Monochrome black line art only; designed to suit any autumnal colouring palette chosen by the customer.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: No tonal fills, gradients, hatching or solid black shadows; depth is conveyed through overlaps, contour lines and sparse interior accents.; texture: Clean white-paper finish with no simulated grain, speckling or distressed effects, ensuring clear home-print results.; mood: Warm, gentle, playful and quietly nostalgic, with a relaxed seasonal feel..

PAGE 4 of "Autumn Railway Journey Colouring Book" (colouring): Warm platform farewell scene: vintage steam train paused beside a country platform, child leaning from an open carriage window waving, exactly two relatives on the platform waving back, one traveller at the carriage door holding a small bag, blank-faced station clock without numbers, simple bench, low hedge and scattered autumn leaves; bold readable gestures, no signs.

PAGE DETAIL: The vintage steam train pauses at a country platform. A child leans from an open carriage window waving to two relatives on the platform, while another traveller stands at the carriage door with a small bag. A station clock without numbers, a bench, fallen leaves and a low hedge complete the scene. Notes: Check that exactly two farewell relatives stand on the platform and that the clock face has no numerals or lettering. Keep the carriage windows large and uncluttered.

BOOK CONSISTENCY: This is page 4 of 10 in one colouring book whose style the owner approved from pages 2, 3, 10. Draw it in exactly that approved style: the same line weight and line quality, the same level of detail and colouring difficulty, the same visual density, border treatment and page margins, the same black-and-white treatment and the same character designs where characters appear. Do not restyle this page.

CANVAS: A single landscape design with a plain white background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It is a colouring page: clean closed outlines on white, no grey fills or shading, easy to colour. Each landscape page uses a wide, fully contained railway scene with generous closed colouring areas and all essential artwork comfortably inside the safe margins. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any reference wording, creator marks, badges, lettering shapes or cover-layout arrangements; The reference sunroom, café or wooden Halloween-stage compositions and their character groupings; Photorealism, realistic anatomy, elaborate perspective or intricate engraving; Dense micro-details, cluttered pages, hairline strokes and tiny enclosed colouring areas; Grey shading, colour fills, gradients, hatching, distressed textures or heavy black ink coverage; Misspelled text, illegible lettering or text-dependent page designs.
